description: This Java class defines a data transfer object (DTO) called NoteResponse, used to represent note data in responses within a web API. It includes fields for id, title, content, ownerId, createdAt, and updatedAt, along with getter and setter methods. The class is annotated with Swagger annotations for API documentation purposes.
